## `measure.densitometer`

Reads densities at a point, like a hand densitometer.

- Owner: CHB-003
- On: Image (scanner-density, film-dyes, printing-density, paper-dyes, print-xyz) → Value
- Class: measure; binding: pixel
- Implementation: mock

| Argument | Type | Unit | Range | Usual | Default | Recipe path | Doc |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `at` | point | px |  |  | `{"x":0,"y":0}` |  | Centre in source px. |
| `aperture_px` | number | px | [1, 200] |  | `9` |  | Aperture diameter. |
| `response` (optional) | enum status-a/status-m/visual |  |  |  |  |  | Densitometric response; absent = chosen by domain. |

Returns:

- `D`: vec3 (D) — density per channel
- `visual`: number (D), optional — visual density (print-xyz only)

- Owner: CHB-003
- On: Image (any) → Value

| Argument | Type | Unit | Range | Usual | Default | Recipe path | Doc |
